reported_success.location: Bischoff (2024), PDF p.23, Discussion, second paragraph (study-level verdict)
reported_success.quote:
The current study successfully replicated the stress induction of Zhang et al. (2018) shown by
increases in cardiovascular measures and cortisol levels. However, RFA was contrary to the predictions
not significantly affected by the experimental condition. Similarly, the expected response patterns
between baseline RFA and cortisol and cardiovascular responses each was not observed.

notes: Study-level author narrative verdict only; an effect-specific verdict cannot be selected from the supplied broad description. Original locator p.17 could not be checked without the full original. Replication Table 3 (PDF p.10) gives male direct-replication N=32 and mixed-sex N=68; these are not assigned as analytic n for an unidentified target test. The methods exclusion paragraph is internally inconsistent (83 tested, sixteen excluded, final 68); no correction was calculated. Appendix A (PDF p.31) reproduces an original correlation table, but it does not identify which target row/column is intended and is not treated as independently acquired original full text. No statistics were selected by input order.
